subject: Risk & Compliance
title: SOC 2 and Trust Reports
description: A micro-lesson that makes SOC 2 and Trust Reports usable.

hook.text: A client asks your company: 'Prove your systems are secure.' Without SOC 2, you can't.

buildup.text: SOC 2 is an audit framework that tests a company's security, availability, and data handling controls.

discovery.text: Passing SOC 2 means an independent auditor verified your security controls over a period of time.

twist.text: SOC 2 reports are often mandatory for selling to enterprises. No report, no deal.

climax.text: SOC 2 turned security from a cost center into a sales enabler. Compliance opens doors.

punchline.text: Prove you're secure or lose the contract. That's SOC 2.

quiz.question: What does a SOC 2 report verify?
options: A company's security controls were independently audited
That a company uses the latest technology
